liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **The Other One** (3 reviews): The transition from The Other One to Stella Blue is described as rip-roaring; The reviewer considers this version superior to any other, noting it gets downright nasty [17][18][19]
- **Stella Blue** (2 reviews): Jerry sings with strong emotion, and the song ends with an epic finish; The bridge is described as the most soulful the reviewer has ever heard [11][19]
- **The Promised Land** (1 review): Jerry and Bob engage in a fast, hard strumming duel at the song's end [21]

## The recordings

- **gd1978-10-21.mtx.seamons.94852.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 22 songs; 199 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd1978-10-21.sbd.miller.89721.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 22 songs; 197 min; rated 3.83/5 by 6 [2]. Said about its sound: An audience patch is present but inaudible due to the band playing very loud; The audio is crystal clear and captures a high-energy performance [11][19]
- **gd1978-10-21.aud.rhinotrocity5.motb-0015.94600.flac24**: audience recording; 22 songs; 197 min; rated 5/5 by 3 [3]. Said about its sound: The mix heavily favors Bob, highlighting his excellent rhythm guitar skills [21]
- **gd1978-10-21.166112.aud.remaster.acetboy.flac1644**: audience recording; 22 songs; 197 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [4]
- **gd1978-10-21.aud.rhinotrocity5.motb-0015.94599.flac16**: audience recording; 22 songs; 197 min; rated 3.5/5 by 4 [5]. Said about its sound: Bobby’s guitar is heavily featured, especially in the first set [15]
- **gd1978-10-21.sonyecm280.martin-bunton.102074.flac16**: source not stated; 23 songs; 207 min; rated 2.5/5 by 2 [6]. Said about its sound: The recording has good sound, low hiss, complete content, and good levels [20]

## Around the show

- Lee Oskar plays eerie harmonica but sounds overwhelmed against the full band in space [15]
- Reviewer hitchhiked from Oregon, slept in the gravel parking lot, and shared homegrown cannabis [16]
- A stranger announced the reviewer's lack of ticket to the gathered street people, who took up a collection [16]
- Mickey Hart played a huge Gong brought back from Egypt during the drum segment [22]
- The audience was dancing during the performance of this song [22]
- Lee Oskar plays harmonica on Drums, Got My Mojo Workin', and Sugar Magnolia [2]
- The commercial release severely edited this song to six minutes, removing significant material [13]
- The commercial release fades out during this jam, unlike the complete sequence here [13]
- The show was released on Road Trips, removing other available soundboard and matrix files [17]
- The show was released on Road Trips, removing other available soundboard and matrix files [18]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1978-10-21.mtx.seamons.94852.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Hunter Seamons; source: Matrix mix (SBD/AUD) [1]. Also: Transfers and mastering were done by Charlie Miller using specific digital and analog equipment; Digital noise spots in this song were patched using material from another source [1]
- **gd1978-10-21.sbd.miller.89721.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Reel -> Dat (44.1k) D [2]. Also: Patch material was supplied by Pat Lee and transferred by Matt Smith [2]
- **gd1978-10-21.aud.rhinotrocity5.motb-0015.94600.flac24**: taped by Reinhart Hohlwein; transferred by Bob Menke and Derek McCabe and Jeff Thomas; source: 2 x AKG d224e => Sony TC 158 => 3 x Maxell UDXL II [3]. Also: A patch was applied to this song using the soundboard recording as the source [3]
- **gd1978-10-21.166112.aud.remaster.acetboy.flac1644**: taped by Reinhart Hohlwein; transferred by acetboy; source: This is a remaster of the Reinhart Hohlwein shn #94600 by acetboy [4]. Also: The remaster uses an alternative audience recording for patches, replacing the previous soundboard source [4]
- **gd1978-10-21.aud.rhinotrocity5.motb-0015.94599.flac16**: taped by Reinhart Hohlwein; transferred by Bob Menke and Derek McCabe and Jeff Thomas; source: 2 x AKG d224e => Sony TC 158 >> 3 x Maxell UDXL II [5]
- **gd1978-10-21.sonyecm280.martin-bunton.102074.flac16**: taped by Mike Martin;Mark Bunton; transferred by Mike Martin; source: Recorded by: Mike Martin and Mark Bunton. Our location was on the floor under the mirrored ball about 20-25 feet from the stage dead center. Equipment: 2 Sony… [6]

citations.quote_or_claim: Everyone talks about the Stella Blue which is nice but I have heard better, with all due respect to those who exalted this version. The Bertha> Goodlovin,…
